show.description: Varasdara – A Forgotten Son is a powerful saga where destiny makes a cruel mistake. A mother’s jealousy swaps two newborns, turning a rightful heir into a forgotten son. Raised in poverty and pain, Adi grows up rich in values, while the true prince loses his way in privilege. When fate brings Adi back to the empire meant for him, buried secrets explode—proving that true royalty is not born in blood, but earned through love, sacrifice, and character.
